name: azure-eventhub-dotnet
summary: 微软的技能节选说明了如何在 .NET 项目中添加 `Azure.Messaging.EventHubs` 包，以向 Azure Event Hubs 发送事件并从中接收事件。若使用 `EventProcessorClient` 保存消费进度以便后续恢复，还需添加 `Azure.Storage.Blobs` 包。

Microsoft’s skill excerpt shows how to add `Azure.Messaging.EventHubs` to a .NET project to send events and receive them from Azure Event Hubs. For consumers that need to resume from saved positions, its `EventProcessorClient` checkpointing setup also requires `Azure.Storage.Blobs`.
